decided: A chain setting written wrongly, such as a value that is not true or false, or a key orbit does not know, quietly lets the AI run nothing on its own, with no warning printed.
alternatives: print a warning naming the wrong entry each time the change status is read, as the size and review settings do
why: A wrong entry already falls back to today's behaviour, where you run every step yourself, so nothing unsafe follows from it; and the status the workflows read at every step should stay free of repeated warnings.
detail: resolveChainSetting in src/core/project-config.ts returns configured:false for an absent or non-map value and grants a key only when its value is the boolean true; unlike resolveSizeCeiling and resolveReviewPreference it never calls console.warn.
